title: Revenue OS
prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE DESIGN COMP for LeadGenBureau, a Russian B2B sales automation agency with its own products. This is candidate A, Revenue OS. Output a single landscape 3:2 raster of an actual website surface, frontal view, no device frame, no browser chrome, no collage. Show the homepage opening plus the beginning of a meaningful product demonstration. This must read as a usable premium website, not a poster, presentation slide or generic SaaS wireframe.

STRUCTURE: A slim navigation at top: custom typographic wordmark "LeadGenBureau" left, "Решения", "Подход" in center, a clear button "Обсудить задачу" right. Main opening beneath: huge confident Cyrillic grotesk headline across the top-left and center, with generous space, the exact three-line text "Больше продаж. / Меньше потерь. / На каждом этапе." Small explanatory text below: "Находим клиентов, квалифицируем интерес и помогаем отделу продаж двигать сделки дальше." Main CTA "Обсудить задачу". The lower half is dominated by ONE wide precise product operating surface extending almost the full width, not a grid of feature cards. It shows a coherent handoff across "Спрос", "Квалификация", "Сделка", "Следующий шаг". A selected step opens one legible deal panel with heading "NeuroROP", company "Компания Север", state "КП на согласовании", a risk "Следующий контакт не назначен", a recommendation "Уточнить участников и дату решения" and one accountable action. Explicit visible label "Демонстрационный сценарий · данные вымышлены". On the bottom edge one compact horizontal product availability line: "Лидогенерация — работает", "AI-звонилка — MVP", "NeuroROP — пилот".

ART DIRECTION: executive operations planning and Swiss corporate identity with a forceful ultramarine-blue area occupying about one third of the opening, contrasting with crisp nearly white content and dark ink. Precise strong grid, purposeful asymmetric mass, extremely well set dense narrow Cyrillic display sans (Golos/Onest-like character, not default Arial or generic rounded tech type), clear quieter readable UI body type. Matte flat surfaces, fine functional dividers, mostly square corners with subtle functional radii, no soft shadow piles. The key focal moment is the continuous horizontal handoff surface; the blue field integrates with the headline and action, not scattered decoration. Navigation, controls, type, deal panel and progression all share one precise corporate system. Feel commercially credible and distinctive, expensive and restrained with one decisive saturated field. No faux dashboard vanity numbers, tiny stock charts, icon-card grids or empty data visuals.

CONTENT RULES: render the stated Russian wording accurately and only short useful labels; no made-up customers, KPI percentages, growth figures, testimonials, pricing or awards. No sale-completed status. Products are separate offerings with a planned connected approach, not proof that one finished software platform exists. No robots, neon glow, gradients, glassmorphism, particles, floating 3D spheres, competitor logos or copyright brand imagery. No small uppercase eyebrow labels above the headline. Strong hierarchy, legible type, evident CTA.
